question: 历史动态合格股票池的焦点动量上穿0，以及指数长期趋势过滤，是否帮助观察下一个交易月的指数修复，超过指数动量/均线和同池涨跌的解释
decision_use: 沪深300宽基低频观察，约一月为主、约一季仅固定敏感性；不产生交易规则或账户收益
evidence_status: exploratory previously seen history; no unseen validation
method_identity: independent local definition; not exact Douyin reconstruction
target: CSI300 total return index, frozen original inputs.json CSI300 SHA; reference index not selected stock portfolio
label: close(t+1+h)/close(t+1)-1; minimum close including t+1 through t+1+h relative to t+1; contiguous exchange sessions required

events.focus_up: focus(t-1)<=0 and focus(t)>0, only adjacent valid exchange sessions
events.focus_negative: focus<0 state; not event or opportunity label

baselines: categorical joint state of indexM20 sign / close>SMA200 / same-poolM20 sign / breadth>=0.5
primary_metric: next20 mean index return difference between focus_up and non-event controls standardized to event distribution across the 16 baseline states; pp. Descriptive conditional increment, not causality or trading profit. No pre-agreed economically meaningful cutoff.
increment: state-standardized event-minus-control mean and positive-share differences
trend-filter retained vs removed focus_up: count, positive/negative, mean and five largest missed gains/five avoided losses

uncertainty.method: moving calendar block resampling of all common date rows; recompute state-weighted event/control difference preserving event clusters
uncertainty.min_cell_support: >=1 event and >=1 non-event observed; sparse cell counts and unmatched exclusions shown; no significance threshold tuning

stability: all first upcross events, overlap counts; no retrospective trough picking
samples: Each comparison same dates, forecast availability and full target maturity. Both universe versions retained; fields from date t only. Missing rows break crossings. No forward fill. Report unsupported source gaps.
success_falsification: Conclude limited benefit only if magnitude/uncertainty and period checks support meaningful separation beyond specified baseline; mixed or null preserved, no parameter search. Complete-account usefulness remains untested.

budgets.prior: Original core1+independent audit1+literature6 and continuation6/gap600 retained unchanged

scope: No production UI changes/alerts/trades/fees/paid data or downloads. No ERP rerun. No archive raw code imports. Technical FactorLab supports no sentiment-market-state adapter; independent existing observation family route retained.
known_limits: vendor roster not certified full historical PIT coverage
20day focus returns price-adjusted but index target total return, interpretation stated
same history used in other studies and model critique
conditional baseline categorical and may leave continuous confounding
not an account simulation; fees/slippage/holding rules not modelled
